selected_approach.name: Recipient-scoped soft archive with archived view and restore
selected_approach.reason: It removes handled notifications from the active user experience while preserving cross-recipient isolation and durable workflow and business audit evidence.

alternatives.name: Frontend-only hiding of read notifications
alternatives.rejected_because: It cannot synchronize across devices, provide reliable recovery or keep server pagination and counts consistent.

alternatives.name: Physical deletion
alternatives.rejected_because: A notification is shared by recipients and supports business traceability, so deletion can remove evidence or affect other users.

interfaces.name: GET /api/notifications
interfaces.contract: Accept view=ALL|UNREAD|ARCHIVED; default to ALL; preserve unreadOnly behavior when view is absent; always scope results to the authenticated recipient.

interfaces.name: GET /api/notifications/modules
interfaces.contract: Return module options and counts consistent with the requested active or archived view for the authenticated recipient.

interfaces.name: PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/archive
interfaces.contract: Archive one authenticated recipient row only when read; reject unread state explicitly; remain idempotent.

interfaces.name: PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/restore
interfaces.contract: Clear archived_at for the authenticated recipient and retain read state; remain idempotent.

interfaces.name: PATCH /api/notifications/archive-read
interfaces.contract: Archive all active read rows for the authenticated recipient and return the actual changed count.

transitions: reload active list, modules and unread count

error_handling.condition: Archive targets an unread active notification
error_handling.behavior: Return HTTP 409 with a clear read-before-archive message and retain the row unchanged.
error_handling.recovery: The user reads the notification and retries archive.

error_handling.condition: Notification is absent or outside the authenticated tenant/user scope
error_handling.behavior: Do not reveal cross-scope existence and do not modify any row.
error_handling.recovery: Refresh the current user's notification list.

error_handling.condition: Archive, restore or list request fails
error_handling.behavior: Keep the current client state, show one actionable error and avoid optimistic removal.
error_handling.recovery: Retry the operation or reload the drawer.

error_handling.condition: Business route navigation fails after a notification state change
error_handling.behavior: Show the existing route error without rolling back the durable state transition.
error_handling.recovery: Return to the notification center and retry navigation later.
